name: aioffice
description: AIOffice - Virtual AI Office & Studio unindo Orquestrador-Maestro, OpenOrq, Habblaud, oh-my-pi e replica-skill

scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build:office && electron-builder --config apps/office-desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run build:office && electron-builder --config apps/office-desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:mac:x64: npm run build:office && electron-builder --config apps/office-desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:mac:arm64: npm run build:office && electron-builder --config apps/office-desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:linux: npm run build:office && electron-builder --config apps/office-desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:verify: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/office-web run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm --prefix apps/office-web run i18n:check && npm --prefix apps/office-web run test -- --testTimeout=15000 && npm run desktop:test && node --check apps/office-desktop/bootstrap.cjs && node --check apps/office-desktop/main.mjs && node --check apps/office-desktop/service.mjs && node --check apps/office-desktop/preload.cjs && node --check apps/office-web/mod/antigravity/hook.mjs && node --check scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/release-aioffice.mjs && node --check scripts/create-desktop-update-manifests.mjs
scripts.dev: start "AIOffice Dev" /B cmd /c "cd apps/office-web && npm run dev" && start http://localhost:4747
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/office-web install && node apps/office-web/scripts/maestro.mjs ensure && npm run build
